title: Thường xuân trên đá
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, Ivy on the Stone: ivy climbing an old stone wall, G minor in 3/4 at 54 bpm: a line climbing slowly by step from D4 to Eb5 over eight bars, then easing back down to G; the left hand rocking in the middle (texture flow); the middle in Bb major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
